snippet.title: KRENDEL — Official Gameplay Trailer | Cozy Point & Click Adventure
snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in the whimsical, hand-drawn world of KRENDEL—an atmospheric point-and-click adventure filled with strange creatures, unique sounds, and cozy mysteries.

☕️ Play the free demo starting October 8th!
✨ Add KRENDEL to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4733660/KRENDEL/

About the game:
• A fully hand-drawn visual style inspired by classic atmospheric adventure games
• No words—storytelling unfolds entirely through the environment and ambient sound
• Solve puzzles, explore unusual locations, and meet peculiar locals

Follow us:
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@krendel.game
X: https://x.com/KRENDEL_gameUA

#krendel #indiegame #pointandclick #cozygames #gamedev #steamgames #gaming #adventuregame
